builtin_attempts: sign-in attempt counters, minutes long: a reset only restarts the throttle
builtin_challenges: sign-in challenges, each answered within minutes or expired
cache_warm: a turn's cache-warming obligation, re-armed by the next turn
connection_tickets: one-time connection tickets, thirty minutes long: a device or CLI asks for a new one
device_status_watchers: the sockets watching a device's status, which re-register when they reconnect
monitor_signal_streaks: the fleet monitor's running streak counts, which start again from the next reading
webhook_rate_windows: a webhook's rate-limit windows, minutes long
